name: Enforce Impulse Learning Loop
description: Implement and enforce the impulse learning system: data capture hooks, pattern learning engine, skip decision logic, and monitoring dashboard

tasks.description: Implement data capture hooks in memory-agent.ts and activity.ts

prompt.template:
Implement data capture for impulse learning:

1. Create ImpulseMappingRecord storage:
   - File: src/session/impulse-learning.ts
   - Interface: ImpulseMappingRecord (from spec)
   - In-memory buffer: Map<string, ImpulseMappingRecord>
   - Persist function: flushToDatabase()

2. Add capture hooks:
   - In memory-agent.ts → analyzeIntent() after LLM call
   - In memory-agent.ts → prepare() after impulse creation
   - In activity.ts → executeTask() after completion
   - In activity.ts → execute() after all tasks

3. Implement impulse usage tracking:
   - trackImpulseUsage(response, impulses)
   - Parse response for content references
   - Return usage map per impulse ID

4. Database schema:
   - Create migration for impulse_pattern_mappings table
   - Create migration for memory_agent_performance table
   - Add indexes per spec

Use IMPULSE_LEARNING_REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md Part 1 & 4.

Implement in TypeScript with proper error handling and logging.

tasks.description: Implement pattern extraction, matching, and replay engine

prompt.template:
Implement pattern learning engine:

1. Pattern Extraction:
   - Function: extractPattern(userMessage)
   - Normalize message
   - Detect variables (file paths, identifiers)
   - Create pattern template
   - Return UserPattern object

2. Pattern Matching:
   - Function: matchPattern(userMessage, learnedPatterns)
   - Compute similarity scores
   - Find best match (>75% threshold)
   - Extract variable bindings
   - Return PatternMatch or null

3. Impulse Replay:
   - Function: replayImpulsesFromPattern(match, sessionID)
   - Transform variables to paths/content
   - Create impulses from mapping
   - Return impulses map

4. Pattern Storage:
   - Function: savePattern(pattern)
   - Function: loadPatterns()
   - Query functions for retrieval

Use IMPULSE_LEARNING_REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md Part 2.

Implement in src/session/pattern-learning.ts with unit tests.

tasks.description: Implement skip decision logic and integrate with turn lifecycle

prompt.template:
Implement skip decision logic:

1. Skip Decision Function:
   - Function: shouldSkipMemoryAgentLLM(userMessage, sessionContext)
   - Rule 1: isTrivial(message)
   - Rule 2: isContinuation(message)
   - Rule 3: Pattern match with >85% confidence
   - Rule 4: Activity with contextRequirements
   - Return: { skip, reason, fallback }

2. Fallback Strategies:
   - replayImpulsesFromPattern() for pattern matches
   - Activity.createImpulsesFromRequirements() for activities
   - Keep existing impulses for continuations

3. Turn Lifecycle Integration:
   - Modify turn-lifecycle-hooks.ts
   - Add skip check before memory agent execution
   - Route to fallback if skip
   - Track decision in memory_agent_performance table

4. Performance Tracking:
   - Log skip decisions
   - Track time savings
   - Monitor success rates

Use IMPULSE_LEARNING_REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md Part 3.

Implement in src/session/memory-skip-logic.ts and update turn-lifecycle-hooks.ts.

tasks.description: Implement feedback loop to update pattern metrics

prompt.template:
Implement learning feedback loop:

1. Success Tracking:
   - Function: updatePatternOnSuccess(recordId, responseTime)
   - Update success_count, observation_count
   - Update success_rate
   - Update avg_response_time_ms (exponential moving average)
   - Update last_used timestamp

2. Failure Tracking:
   - Function: updatePatternOnFailure(recordId)
   - Update failure_count, observation_count
   - Recalculate success_rate
   - Mark unreliable if success_rate < 0.5 and observations > 5

3. Integration:
   - Call from activity.ts after task completion
   - Call from turn-lifecycle-hooks.ts after turn completion
   - Pass task success/failure status

4. Pattern Pruning:
   - Function: pruneUnreliablePatterns()
   - Remove patterns with success_rate < 0.3 and observations > 10
   - Archive old patterns (last_used > 90 days)

Use IMPULSE_LEARNING_REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md Part 4.

Implement in src/session/learning-feedback.ts with database queries.

tasks.description: Implement activity template learning and skip gatherContext

prompt.template:
Implement activity template learning:

1. Capture Activity Mappings:
   - In activity.ts → executeActivityWithLearning()
   - After gatherContext() success
   - Capture: template.id, variables, contextRequirements, resolvedImpulses
   - Store in activity_impulse_mappings table

2. Skip gatherContext:
   - Function: getLearnedActivityMapping(templateId, variables)
   - Query activity_impulse_mappings for match
   - Check confidence > 85%
   - Return learned mapping or null

3. Replay Activity Impulses:
   - Function: replayActivityImpulses(mapping, variables)
   - Transform variables to impulses
   - Return impulses map

4. Integration:
   - Modify tool/activity.ts
   - Check for learned mapping before gatherContext()
   - Skip if confident
   - Track skip in metrics

Use IMPULSE_LEARNING_REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md Part 5.

Implement in src/session/activity-learning.ts and update tool/activity.ts.

tasks.description: Implement monitoring dashboard with skip rate and quality metrics

prompt.template:
Implement monitoring dashboard:

1. Metrics Collection:
   - Interface: LearningMetrics (from spec)
   - Function: collectLearningMetrics()
   - Query memory_agent_performance table
   - Query impulse_pattern_mappings table
   - Aggregate skip rates, success rates, time savings

2. Dashboard Queries:
   - skipRateOverTime(days: number)
   - skipReasonBreakdown()
   - patternEffectiveness(limit: number)
   - performanceComparison()

3. Real-time Display:
   - Add to TUI sidebar (if applicable)
   - Display: skip rate, quality delta, time savings
   - Color code: green if quality maintained, red if degraded

4. Alerting:
   - Alert if skip success rate < LLM success rate
   - Alert if pattern utilization < 20%
   - Alert if skip rate plateaus below target

Use IMPULSE_LEARNING_REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md Part 6.

Implement in src/session/learning-metrics.ts with dashboard integration.

tasks.description: Create comprehensive integration tests for learning system

prompt.template:
Create integration tests:

1. Test Data Capture:
   - Run sample turns
   - Verify ImpulseMappingRecords created
   - Verify records persisted to database
   - Verify impulse usage tracked

2. Test Pattern Learning:
   - Provide sample user messages
   - Verify patterns extracted
   - Verify patterns matched
   - Verify impulses replayed correctly

3. Test Skip Logic:
   - Test trivial message skip
   - Test continuation skip
   - Test pattern match skip
   - Test activity template skip
   - Verify fallback strategies work

4. Test Feedback Loop:
   - Simulate successes and failures
   - Verify pattern metrics updated
   - Verify unreliable patterns marked
   - Verify pruning works

5. Test End-to-End:
   - Run 100-turn session
   - Measure skip rate (target: 60-80%)
   - Compare success rates (skip vs LLM)
   - Verify quality maintained

Implement in test/session/learning-system.test.ts with assertions.

Generate test report with skip rate and quality metrics.
